# ClickerOverride-Improved

> An AutoHotkey v1 script for Windows that intercepts Page Up/Page Down (or Left/Right Arrow) key presses from a wireless presentation clicker and silently forwards them to a target window of your choice — without requiring that window to be in focus.

This is a fork and complete rewrite of ClickerOverride by 4000degrees (https://github.com/4000degrees/ClickerOverride).

## What it does

ClickerOverride-Improved solves a specific problem: during a live presentation, the person operating the presentation PC needs to work in other applications while a presenter uses a wireless clicker to advance slides. Without this script, clicking the clicker advances the focused window — not the slide show. This script intercepts the clicker's keystrokes globally and forwards them to the correct window regardless of focus.

## Key capabilities

- Intercepts Page Up/Page Down or Left/Right Arrow globally via AutoHotkey keyboard hooks
- Forwards configurable output keystrokes to any selected target window
- Three focus modes: background send (Mode 1), briefly activate and restore (Mode 2), activate and stay (Mode 3)
- GUI window selector lists all open windows at startup; includes a Refresh button
- Works with PowerPoint Presenter View, PowerPoint full-screen slide show, Pympress PDF presenter, and any app that accepts Page Up/Down or Left/Right Arrow for navigation
- Single-instance enforcement; modifier-key passthrough
- Distributed as both a compiled .exe (no AutoHotkey required) and a raw .ahk script

## Supported software

- Microsoft PowerPoint (full-screen with Presenter View, full-screen without Presenter View, windowed mode)
- Pympress (PDF presentation viewer for dual-screen setups)
- Any Windows application that accepts keyboard navigation via Page Up/Down or Left/Right Arrow

## Requirements

- Windows (any modern version)
- AutoHotkey v1.1 (AutoHotkey Classic) — only required if running the .ahk script; the .exe release is standalone

## Not compatible with

- AutoHotkey v2 (breaking syntax changes; a v2 port does not currently exist)
- macOS or Linux
- Clicker devices that communicate via proprietary protocols rather than as standard keyboard devices

## Files

- ClickerOverride-Improved-ahk1.ahk — the full AutoHotkey v1 source script
- CONTRIBUTING.md — contribution guidelines
- assets/ — screenshots used in the README
